about: The secreta of the formulary “Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the human nature of Your Only-begotten, O Lord, come to our help, so that He who was born of the Virgin, and did not lessen His mother’s integrity but hallowed it, may, in the solemnities of her Nativity, strip us of our offenses and make our oblation acceptable in Your sight: Jesus Christ our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
